propositions: A new immutable OperationSnapshot type must centrally compose validated non-secret configuration from five explicit layers (explicit input > environment > project config > user config > schema default) with provenance tracking, repository root selection, and serializable envelope versioning.
Repository root selection must occur independently via explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT env > Git top-level/cwd, with relative paths interpreted against the selected root.

Shadow mode (default-enabled via REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW) must thread one snapshot through CLI, public library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points without altering execution or stored formats, comparing only version/sources/fingerprint.

Snapshot fields must exclude live auth objects, secrets, provider clients, source-file paths, and subprocess environments; secret environment sentinels must be absent from serialization, fingerprints, diagnostics, logs, schemas, and all boundaries.

Malformed selected config must raise typed config error before lock/network/write effects; other shadow failures in shadow mode must emit redacted warnings and leave authoritative operations unchanged.
REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW can be set to canonical false to disable shadow construction and restore legacy behavior, with removal planned for S7.
